derivedArtifacts.derivation: Decoded the Project Gutenberg source's declared ISO-8859 text as Latin-1 instead of UTF-8, selected the complete original Book III span, normalized CRLF to LF, and appended one deterministic exclusive end marker. This restores printed forms such as ‘Phænomena’ without editorially changing the text.
